target_customer: Brands and e-commerce businesses that send marketing and transactional texts
problem: Plain SMS is low engagement. Smobi offers branded, interactive RCS messages with AI built flows, carrier vetting and compliance handled for the customer.
business_model: Usage based messaging API and campaign platform

founders.name: Kunal Puri
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was founding product lead at Hanover Park, building AI tools for fund accountants.

competitors.name: Infobip
competitors.what: Cloud communications platform supporting RCS Business Messaging for brands, such as the BT launch

technical_complexity.rationale: RCS needs carrier and Google integrations, brand verification and SMS fallback, plus compliance such as TCPA and 10DLC. A small team can build on aggregators, as Smobi later did with Vonage.

defensibility.rationale: The platform sits on carrier and CPaaS rails that large messaging vendors also sell. Compliance know how and analytics are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large CPaaS vendors sold RCS directly. Vonage became Smobi's RCS provider in April 2025 rather than a rival.

market_need_then: Apple announced in November 2023 that it would adopt RCS, a tailwind for business RCS in the US. Before that, RCS reach on iPhones was missing.

branding.domain_note: Owns smobi.com, a short exact match .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual marketing copy with the tagline Made to be tapped and the line brands that text like humans and scale like software

brand_strength.rationale: Short and memorable name with a tagline, but only trade press about the Vonage partnership was found, nothing about the brand itself.

pivots.from: New age marketplace for businesses for sale (earlier YC launch post)
pivots.to: Business texting over RCS (current YC launch post)
pivots.why: Not stated. The CTO's YC bio still mentions the marketplace.

outcome_analysis: Smobi started as a marketplace for businesses for sale and pivoted to RCS business messaging, shipping an API and AI flows. A Vonage partnership was announced in April 2025 and the site was live with a 2026 copyright. Only about 500 thousand dollars from YC is reported. The YC directory marks it inactive at one point but other sources show activity, so its outcome is unresolved.
notes: Status conflict: the YC page fetch showed Inactive, a search summary of the same directory showed Active, and the site was live in 2026, so exit is recorded as none. Funding conflict: CB Insights lists a 0.5M convertible note dated 2023-01-01 (before the batch, likely wrong), VCBacked lists pre-seed in 2023-09; Village.ai also names TwentyTwo Ventures, unconfirmed. The $500K rests on aggregators. The Infobip source is dated March 2021 and describes support for BT; Infobip's own RCS solution release is dated February 2024.
